query: INSERT INTO kitchen_ticket_items (id, org_id, kitchen_ticket_id, station_id, menu_item_id, line, qty, open_ticket_item_id) SELECT COALESCE(u.id, gen_random_uuid()), $1, $2, u.station, u.menu_item, u.line, u.qty, u.bill_line FROM UNNEST($3::uuid[], $4::uuid[], $5::uuid[], $6::jsonb[], $7::int4[], $8::uuid[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(id, station, menu_item, line, qty, bill_line, ord) ORDER BY u.ord ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
